name: Jefferson River (Canyon / Three Forks)
blurb: Lime-cliff canyon by the Caverns, then braided water into Missouri Headwaters.

sections.notes: The Jefferson canyon. Long day. Lewis & Clark Caverns State Park is midway.
River opens up and braids. Irrigation can drain this stretch in late summer.
Ends where the Jefferson, Madison, and Gallatin become the Missouri.
